DESCRIPTION:
This home is built on a 1 kanal and 4 marla plot (6,528 sq ft), with a total built-Up area of approximately 5000 sq ft (Approx.) across the ground and first floors. It is located in jagti, ideally positioned between iim jammu and iit jammu, approximately 500 meters from both institutions. The structure has been designed to accommodate a ground + 3-Floor configuration; However, only the ground and first floors have been constructed at present.

Details: 3 bedrooms with dressing rooms, 2 livings areas (One at ground floor and one at first floor), 1 study room, four bathrooms, 1 big store, 1 store in the kitchen garden, 1additional room with kitchen and bathroom for servant.

 Construction details: Reinforcement: 25 mm rebars are used in the beams, and 20 mm rebars in the columns.

 Foundation: The plinth is 8 feet deep, with structural engineering drawings strictly followed.

 Concrete: M25 grade concrete has been used throughout the building.

 Bricks & materials: High-Quality bricks and construction materials are used.

 Waterproofing & termite protection: Comprehensive waterproofing of the roof and walls, and termite-Proofing are completed.

 High-Quality marble and granite are used.

 Efficiency & comfort: Insulation: Walls and roof are insulated with puf (Polyurethane foam) for excellent thermal efficiency, ensuring low air conditioning needs.

 Soundproofing: The home is fully soundproofed for added comfort.

 Fittings & finish: Premium fixtures: High-End kitchen and bathroom fittings have been installed.

 Branded materials: Only top-Quality, branded materials are used, including: Tata rebars ultratech

 Cement (Ultratech weather plus) astral plumbing pipes apollo pipes legrand switches simpolo tiles

 High quality marble elica and kaff kitchen appliances rr kabel for cables and electric fittings.

 Sanitaryware & fittings: Premium jaquar fittings are used in bathrooms and kitchens. All materials, including sand and aggregate, are quality-Checked before use.

 Supervision: The entire construction was carried out under the close supervision of an experienced architect, civil engineer, and interior designer.
